entries.german:
Die Generalvikare von Konstanz verleihen an Rudolf von Rorschach die Eigenleute bei Hugelshofen, die er von Elisabeth und deren Gemahl Rudolf dem Meier von Altstätten gekauft hat.

Nos vicarii episcopatus Constantiensis auctoritate sedis apostolice in spiritualibus et temporalibus generales notum facimus presentium inspectoribus universis, quod || constituto in nostri presentia sub anno domini millesimo trecentesimo vicesimo primo feria sexta ante festum beati Thome apostoli proxima iudicii in figura stren||nuo viro Egelolfo de Rosemberg 1 milite sententialiter coram venerabili in Christo domino Hiltboldo dei gratia abbate monasterii sancti Galli 2 tamquam coram iudice || ad hoc conpetenti honeste matrone Eli sab et uxori Rv od. dicti Maier de Altstetten 3 armigeri ad infrascripta pro advocato, qui vulgariter ain vogt dicitur, deputato, prout in litteris 4 super hoc confectis et sigillis domini abbatis, Rud. et Egelolfi predictorum sigillatis vidimus contineri, idem Egelolfus nomine advocaticio Eli sab et predicte fatebatur, eandem Elisabetam de ipsius Egelolfi tamquam sui advocati consensu auctoritate et voluntate necnon Růdolfum eiusdem Elisabet maritum legittimum omnes homines aput Hugoltshouen 5et alibi residentes ad predictam Elis ab et am iure hereditario seu quo vis alio modo devolutos strennuo viro Rud. de Roschach 6 militi rite et legittime vendidisse et in ipsum suosque heredes omne ius et accionem ipsis in predictis hominibus usque in hec tempora quovis modo conpetentes legaliter transtulisse, adhibitis circa premissa omnia et singula verborum et gestuum sollempnitatibus debitis et consuetis. Et quia predictos homines ab ecclesia Constantiensi prefata Elisabet in feudum tenebat, predictus Egelolfus nomine advocatitio Elisabet prescripte predictos homines unâ cum Elisabet predicta presente ad manus nostras sponte et libere resignavernt a), petentes a nobis, ut predictum Růd. de Roschach militem de huiusmodi hominibus nostra auctoritate dignaremur infeudare et contractum predictum ratificare. Nos itaque recepta a predictis Egelolfo et Elisabet libera resignacione hominum predictorum sepedictum Rud. de Roschach militem presentem et in se infeudacionem infrascriptam recipientem auctoritate, qua fungimur, de predictis hominibus infeudavimus rite et legittime per presentes, approbantes et ratificantes vendicionem hominum predictorum, in quantum illam de iure possumus approbare. Et quia premissis sigilla predictorum Egelolfi, Rud. et Elisabet appensa vidimus, idcirco sigillum vicariatus nostri, quo utimur, presentibus duximus appendendum in testimonium omnium premissorum, adhibitis in premissis omnibus et singulis verborum et gestuum sollempnitatibus debitis et consuetis. Datum et actum Constantie, anno et die predictis, indc. quinta.

Siegel: 4 Siegel, 1. 0 4,5 cm, besch., +S.VICARIORVM.EPATVS.CONS(TA)NCIEN (UB Zürich Siegelabb. X/43); 2. Abb. 161; 3. besch., Abb. 166; 4. fehlt.
entries.english:
We, the general vicars of the bishopric of Constance, acting by apostolic authority in spiritual and temporal matters, make known to all who see this letter that, in the year of the Lord 1321, on the Friday immediately before the feast of St. Thomas the Apostle, the following matter was brought before us in court. In the presence of the venerable lord in Christ, Hiltbold, by God’s grace abbot of the monastery of St. Gall, as the competent judge, the honorable lady Elisabeth, wife of Rudolf called Maier of Altstätten, squire, appeared with Egelolf von Rosenberg, knight, appointed as her advocate (commonly called a Vogt) for the matter below, as we saw stated in the instrument drawn up for this purpose and sealed by the abbot, Rudolf, and the said Egelolf. Egelolf, acting as advocate for the said Elisabeth, declared that Elisabeth, with his consent, authority, and approval as her advocate, and Rudolf, her lawful husband, had duly and lawfully sold to Rudolf von Rorschach, knight, all the people at Hugelshofen and elsewhere who had come to Elisabeth by inheritance or in any other way, and had lawfully transferred to him and his heirs every right and claim they had in those people up to that time. All due and customary formalities of words and acts were observed in this matter.

Because Elisabeth held the said people in fief from the Church of Constance, Egelolf, acting as her advocate, together with Elisabeth, who was present, voluntarily and freely surrendered them into our hands and asked us to enfeoff Rudolf von Rorschach with those people by our authority and to ratify the transaction. Accordingly, after receiving the free surrender of the said people from Egelolf and Elisabeth, we have duly and lawfully enfeoffed the present Rudolf von Rorschach, who accepts the enfeoffment set out below, with those people by the authority we exercise, and we approve and ratify their sale to the extent that we may lawfully approve it. Since we have seen the seals of Egelolf, Rudolf, and Elisabeth attached to the foregoing, we have therefore caused the seal of our vicariate, which we use, to be attached to this document as testimony to all the foregoing. All due and customary formalities of words and acts were observed in each part of this matter. Given and done at Constance in the year and on the day stated above, in the fifth indiction.

Seals: Four seals; the first is damaged, with the inscription “+S.VICARIORVM.EPATVS.CONS(TA)NCIEN”; the second is shown in illustration 161; the third is damaged and shown in illustration 166; the fourth is missing.
